text:
clare: rolling tenant_metadata backfill btf-601 on prod-shard-4. requesting lease. tagging @omar and @dba for watch.

deploybot: Lease assigned to operator-4 for job btf-601. config: chunk=600, concurrency=2, sleep=300ms. stall_watch=on. ETA ~13m.

omar: tailing pg_stat_activity. quick heads up: write traffic spike expected in ~10m from batch worker. consider reducing concurrency if needed.

dba: noted. preflight check passed. set abort_on_lock=true.

deploybot: progress 10% -> 28%. no long locks yet.

omar: p99 trending up to ~380ms. two waiters for ~6s on user_metadata. setting an alert threshold: if long_lock_count >=2 within 60s -> pause.

infra-bot: auto-pause rule armed. will create incident if force-abort executed.

clare: lowering concurrency to 1 and increasing sleep to 700ms to be cautious.

deploybot: live config applied. concurrency=1 sleep=700ms.

omar: metrics stabilized. incoming batch traffic just started; I'm watching for lock intersections.

deploybot: stall alert at 00:05:14 long_lock_count=2 longest_lock=8s. waiting for manual input for 45s before auto-abort.

clare: issuing graceful pause to let batch finish: `./backfillctl pause --job btf-601 --grace 30s`

deploybot: pause acknowledged by workers. holding state.

dba: batch completed. locks cleared. safe to resume.

clare: resuming with same conservative config.

deploybot: resume executed. job btf-601 resumed.

omar: running additional watch for next 15m. if anything recurs we'll abort and pin to v2.18.0.

clare: agreed. will only unpin after successful canary + 12h monitoring. posting release-note: "btf-601 paused due to overlapping batch traffic; no abort; no pin applied; resumed with reduced concurrency."
